description: This file defines the StreamInterface interface within the Psr\Http\Message namespace, describing a data stream with methods for reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving metadata.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the stream to a string by reading all data from the beginning to the end.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and any underlying resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Separates underlying resources from the stream, rendering it unusable.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file read/write pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at the end.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Seeks to the beginning of the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns remaining contents of the stream as a string.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata as an array or specific key.
